Thanks again for the conversation this morning - great to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed plan so our teams can align before the kickoff.

Call highlights / success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: p95 inference < 150ms for 512-token prompts (production-like load).
- Cost: target unit economics goal for your use-case (we'll track tokens / cache hit rate).
- Data controls: audit logs for all API calls, option for VPC if required.
- Functional: conversational generation with function/tool calling and embeddings for search reranking.

Proposed evaluation plan / timeline:
1) Week 0 (May 17) - Kickoff: alignment on dataset, success criteria, owner contacts.
2) Week 1 (May 18 - 24) - Hosted trial (fast path): API key + sample dataset, run canonical eval prompts, measure latency/cost.
3) Week 2 (May 25 - 31) - Deep validation: longer runs, stress tests, and integration verification (SSO, audit logs).
4) Optional Week 3 - If data isolation is mandatory, parallel VPC trial with our onboarding checklist.

Ownership:
- Evergreen: Sophie (Product) - product success criteria; Tom (Infra) - networking/security contacts.
- Redwood: Marissa (Account), Dev Patel (Solutions Eng) - technical setup and runbook; Rishi (AE) - contract/credits.

Immediate next steps (today / this week):
- Sophie/Tom: confirm dataset and a list of 5 representative prompts / flows to validate.
- Evergreen infra: confirm whether a VPC or dedicated sandbox is required for the initial two weeks, or whether hosted is acceptable for Week 1.
- Redwood: share POC playbook and network requirements (attached).
- Schedule kickoff: propose Tue May 18, 10:00 AM PT - reply with availability.

Attachments: poc-playbook.pdf (playbook + success criteria template), network-requirements.xlsx (IP ranges, egress rules).

Looking forward - I'll loop in the SRE team if we need firewall/allowlist support.

Hi Tom / Sophie - wanted to jump in with the technical options and typical timelines so you can pick the right path: 

Option A - Hosted trial (fastest):
- Provision: minutes to a few hours. We provide an API key, example prompts, and a small test instance.
- Data persistence: by default we retain request metadata for troubleshooting; payload retention can be disabled for the trial (we can arrange a no-persist policy per your requirement).
- Audit logs: we can stream audit logs to your SIEM (syslog/S3) for the trial period; full request/response logging needs explicit enable and is configurable.
- Pros: fastest, minimal setup; immediate latency/cost observations.
- Cons: multi-tenant unless you opt for dedicated.

Option B - Dedicated sandbox (managed, customer-isolated):
- Provision: typical lead time ~3 - 5 business days (short config + reserved pool).
- Includes isolated GPU pool, customer-specific credentials, and separate telemetry.
- Pros: strong isolation, faster to provision than full VPC.
- Cons: slightly higher cost and provisioning window.

Option C - VPC trial (best for regulatory/data-sensitive):
- Provision: ~7 - 10 business days + networking ticket and onboarding checklist; requires exchange of ACLs, DNS and possibly a short security questionnaire.
- Pros: complete network isolation, customer-managed routing, KMS/HSM integrations available.
- Cons: longer lead time.

For your immediate question: we can enable a no-persist policy and streaming audit logs to your SIEM for Week 1 (Hosted) so you don't need to send PII to persistent storage. If after Week 1 you want Dedicated sandbox, we can start provisioning in parallel once you sign the short trial addendum.

I attached the architecture diagram and a VPC onboarding checklist for reference.

Next technical steps I suggest:
- Evergreen infra to confirm whether no-persist hosted + SIEM stream is acceptable for initial runs.
- If yes: share a list of allowlisted IPs or we can issue a short-lived allowlist token.
- If not: confirm Dedicated vs VPC and we'll kick off provisioning.

Happy to run the kickoff and do the initial integration steps.

Thanks,

Quick commercial note to supplement Dev's note:
